race.description: Real Punters Play Here Tabtouch Hcp (C3)
race.comment: ENCHANTED HOUR (10) is the top pick with great upside, returning after only two starts. She debuted by winning a Mdn at Bunbury on soft ground, just beating Vexatious Rose by a neck, and finished fourth in a NMW1Y at Pinjarra Scarpside before the break. A recent trial at Lark Hill sets her up well. NATURE'S RECKONING (2) had a solid first-up run here over 1000m, placing after a slow start and interference near the 350m. Her record at 1300m is strong, and Victoria Corver has won twice aboard. DIAMOND DANCER (1) drops from Saturday races after finishing eighth in a NMW1Y at Ascot, beaten by just over two lengths. The claim also helps with the top weight. MISS WALL STREET (13) was overlooked in the market but finished third here last time in Class 5, beaten only a length. Her track-and-distance record and quick back-up make her a genuine chance.
